itinerary.title: Arrival - Jeju City Tour
activities: Suggested arrival: morning arrival
Airport Pickup at Jeju Airport
Yongduam Rock (oceanfront volcanic rock formation in the shape of a dragon's head)
Yongyeon Pond (where water from Hallasan Mountain meets the sea, reflecting its stunning vistas & clear water)
Saryeoni Forest Trail (beautiful forest with easy walking trails)
Iho Tewoo Horse Lighthouse (lighthouse built in the shape of the Jeju's pony)
Dongmun Traditional Market (Jeju's largest & oldest market)
Check-in

itinerary.title: Jeju West & South Tour
activities: Saebyeol Oreum (beautiful in fall with silver grass)
Osulloc Green Tea Farm and Innisfree Jeju House (a tea farm owned by a premium Korean tea brand + Innisfree signature store)
Yongmeori Coast Beach (a hydrovolcano rocky shore formed by volcanic debris)
Cheonjeyeon Waterfalls (famous three-tiered waterfall)

itinerary.title: Jeju East Tour
activities: Songeup Folk Village (Korean traditional village)
Seopjikoji (famous lighthouse at a cliff)
Gimnyeong Beach
Seongsan Ilchulbong (sunrise peak, a crater, one of UNESCO World Heritage Site)

expect.title: Lunch & Dinner Excluded
expect.body: No lunch and dinner, and no breakfast if you choose the apartment. The guide will bring you to a halal-friendly restaurant or convenience store.

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Please bring a maximum of 1 luggage per pax, as it affects car capacity.

expect.title: Driving Guide & Transport
expect.body: 10 hours basis. 30,000 - 60,000 KRW will be charged for each extra hour.

expect.title: Accommodation
expect.body: Rooms are small, typically 15-20 sqf (Korean standard). Triple rooms offer even less space.

expect.title: Free & Easy at Udo
expect.body: Recommended to explore Udo on your own. The island offers a variety of cafes and restaurants, and bike rentals are available for convenience.
